title: SiteShrimp Photo Entry — Construction Site variant
description: Variant for active-site work / WSH-frame defect capture. Construction Site is a DIFFERENT domain from CONQUAS / building-defects: severity is interpreted as injury risk (Critical = fatal/serious-injury, Major = lost-time, Minor = first-aid, Observation = near-miss). Stakeholders are safety officers, not QPs / architects. Consequence of a finding is a stop-work order, not a contractual deduction. The base severity enum is preserved on the wire for ingestion stability — variants augment context, not replace vocabulary.
x-severity-frame: WSH (workplace safety and health), not contractual-defect. See description above for value semantics.

hazard_category.description: Primary hazard class observed in the photo. Drives WSH risk-control routing. Required — every site-safety photo has at least one identifiable hazard class.

ppe_compliance.description: Personal protective equipment compliance observed for workers visible in the photo. 'N/A' for site-condition photos with no workers.

stop_work_recommended.description: True when the hazard severity warrants an immediate stop-work order. AI flags candidates; the safety officer makes the call.

workers_exposed.description: Count of workers visibly exposed to the hazard. Order-of-magnitude estimate is fine; exact headcount not required.
